##: Scoop manifest for Gridkeeper. Install: scoop bucket add gridkeeper https://github.com/raazi29/gridkeeper, then scoop install gridkeeper/gridkeeper.

Format: https://github.com/ScoopInstaller/Scoop/wiki/App-Manifests and App-Manifest-Autoupdate. Like the Tauri apps in ScoopInstaller/Extras (pot, clash-verge-rev), the NSIS setup is unpacked with 7-Zip ('#/dl.7z') instead of run, so nothing is written to the registry; post_install drops the NSIS plugin folder and uninstaller.
version/url/hash are rewritten by scripts/release/update-manifests.mjs after each release; an all-zero hash means that has not happened yet for this version.
notes: Gridkeeper needs the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime (preinstalled on Windows 11; on Windows 10: winget install Microsoft.EdgeWebView2Runtime).
Settings are kept in %APPDATA%\app.gridkeeper.desktop and are not removed on uninstall.
